title: RSHallu: Dual-Mode Hallucination Evaluation for Remote-Sensing Multimodal Large Language Models with Domain-Tailored Mitigation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of hallucinations in remote-sensing multimodal large language models. It establishes a taxonomy for image-level and object-level inconsistencies and proposes a benchmark for accuracy. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, morals, or ethics.
